description: This file contains implementation of the COSA Data Model Library's init and unload APIs, including functions to create, initialize, and remove a backend manager object, along with associated memory management and object setup.

methods.name: CosaBackEndManagerCreate
methods.description: Constructs and returns a new COSA backend manager object, allocating memory and setting function pointers.

methods.name: CosaBackEndManagerInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the backend manager object, creating device info handle.

methods.name: CosaBackEndManagerRemove
methods.description: Removes and frees the backend manager object memory.
